blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Motorists will see another round of fuel price rollbacks on Tuesday, with gasoline prices dropping by P3 per liter, diesel by P2.60, and kerosene by P1.60, according to the Department of Energy. This marks the fourth consecutive week of diesel price cuts and the third straight week of gasoline price reductions, driven by improving global oil supply as exports from the Middle East gradually return to normal.
